list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: Octa-nuclear cerium(III)-containing organic–inorganic hybrid tetrameric lacunary Dawson polyoxometalate

properties.summary: Magnetic measurements indicate antiferromagnetic interactions among the eight Ce(III) ions. Magnetization remains unsaturated up to 70 kOe; the authors attribute this to magnetic anisotropy and/or a low-lying excited state.

source_locations.location: Abstract; crystal data [28]; supplied CCDC catalog formula
Magnetic susceptibility and magnetization discussion; Fig. 3

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Four monovacant Dawson [α2-P2W17O61] units are joined by eight Ce(III) cations into an uncommon zigzag tetrameric polyanion. The tetramer contains two kinds of di-Ce-substituted Dawson segments arranged A–B–B–A, with eight isonicotinic acid ligands coordinated as organic pendants.

synthesis.ph: Adjusted to 4.5 with 2 M NaOH, then to 3.0 with 2 M HCl
synthesis.procedure: CeCl3·7H2O (0.075 g, 0.200 mmol) and isonicotinic acid (0.074 g, 0.600 mmol) were dissolved in 15 mL deionized water. After adjusting the pH to 4.5 with 2 M NaOH, Na12[P2W15O56]·24H2O (0.440 g, 0.100 mmol) was added quickly with vigorous stirring. The pH was readjusted to 3.0 with 2 M HCl. The mixture was heated at 60 °C for 1 h and cooled to ambient temperature. Tetramethylammonium chloride (0.110 g, 1.000 mmol) was added and stirred for 30 min. The solution was sealed in a 25 mL Teflon-lined stainless-steel autoclave, heated at 120 °C for 22 h, and cooled to room temperature.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Hydrothermal reaction in a sealed 25 mL Teflon-lined stainless-steel autoclave
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: After cooling to room temperature, the solution was filtered and allowed to evaporate for several days. Dark red block crystals were collected by filtration and washed with deionized water.

title: A new organic-inorganic hybrid tetrameric polyoxometalate assembled by monovacant Dawson [α2-P2W17O61] and trivalent cerium cations
